cause: Path.is_file checks the old inode; the later blocking Path.open can open a substituted FIFO while the host write transaction remains open. A competing writer was observed locked before each baseline hang.
repair: Walk all path components with nofollow directory descriptors, open final component with O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW, fstat the same descriptor as regular, and bound reads before digesting.
semantic_delta: All symlink components now reject, including in-scope symlinks that old Path.resolve accepted. This is an intentional fail-closed scope restriction; regular-file bytes/digest and16MiB cap are retained.

after: 10 focused cases pass; exact positive race events in artifact_fifo_digest_observed.json show typed denial, rollback, revocation and HOST_GRANT_DENIED restart. Supervisor must replay exact snapshot.
limits: No arbitrary blocking-filesystem latency guarantee; local regular-filesystem fixture only.
